scope: Independent transparent source masters only; runtime integration and owner review remain outside this record.

assets.prompt: Using the approved Moonleaf references as visual authority, create one independent rectangular Elven frame on a truly transparent canvas: polished silver-white metal, muted sage enamel, slender interlaced vines and leaves, and moonlit green accents. Preserve four complete ornate corners and continuous low-detail edge-center bands suitable for protected-cap nine-slice use; keep the entire center and exterior transparent. No text, letters, numbers, glyphs, runes, UI, tablet, relic, scene, or background.
assets.acceptance: Accepted after full-canvas and 200-percent corner inspection: complete protected corners, quiet stretchable edge centers, empty transparent center/exterior, clean antialiased silhouette, and no text or glyph content.
assets.rejectionHistory: The first raster and two transparency corrections retained an opaque checkerboard field and were rejected; the accepted correction contains a real alpha channel. The final PNG received metadata normalization only.

assets.prompt: Using the approved Moonleaf references as visual authority, create one independent noncircular Elven heraldic crest centered on a truly transparent canvas with generous clear margin: a silver crescent embracing moonbloom foliage, deep forest-green enamel, pale moonstone inlay, refined silver filigree, and restrained sage leaves. Keep the silhouette complete and suitable for aspect-fit placement. No text, letters, numbers, glyphs, runes, UI, tablet, relic, frame, scene, or background.
assets.acceptance: Accepted after full-canvas and 200-percent detail inspection: complete independent silhouette, clean antialiased alpha, ample transparent aspect-fit margin, Moonleaf material fidelity, and no text or glyph content.
assets.rejectionHistory: The first raster and two transparency corrections retained an opaque checkerboard field and were rejected. A later margin revision also lost alpha and was rejected. The accepted transparent object was centered by lossless transparent-canvas padding without changing its pixels.
